subject: Security review kickoff & questionnaire intake - Medora Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medorahealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@medorahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff & questionnaire intake - Medora Health

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today — I appreciate the context and the clear timeline. Per our conversation, here's a concise kickoff/next-steps note so both teams are aligned:

Summary of where we landed:
- Goal: complete security review and procurement checklist to enable a Dedicated/Private deployment decision by end of Q3.
- High-level scope: production API, telemetry ingestion pipeline, SSO (Okta), and integration points to Medora's analytics stack.

Action items for Medora (ask):
1) Please review and fill the attached Medora_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf — this helps us prioritize evidence collection (SOC2, network diagrams, data flows).
2) Confirm stakeholder map (economic buyer, security/compliance owner, procurement contact) — sample template in the attached spreadsheet.
3) Clarify systems in-scope (we flagged production infra + analytics ingest; confirm whether dev/test sandboxes are excluded).
4) Share a preferred 60-minute slot next week for a walkthrough of the questionnaire and any outstanding questions.

Tentative Redwood owners: Neha (security questionnaire intake / evidence triage), Sean (technical follow-ups / network diagram review), myself (program lead and procurement coordination).

Attachments: Medora_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf; Medora_Systems_In_Scope.xlsx

Proposed slots (PDT): Tue 9/1 10:00-11:00, Tue 9/1 14:00-15:00, Wed 9/2 11:00-12:00. If none work, please suggest alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

—
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

We can take a first pass on the questionnaire this week; can you confirm whether you need a completed questionnaire before the walkthrough, or if a live walkthrough with partial answers is fine?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & questionnaire intake - Medora Health

Appreciate the fast turnaround and stakeholder names — that's perfect and will help speed procurement. Short clarifications and prep notes before our walkthrough on Tue 9/1 14:00 PDT:

1) Questionnaire: a partial completed questionnaire is fine. During the walkthrough we'll go section-by-section, and Neha will capture action items for evidence collection. If you can complete sections on authentication, data classification, and third-party services ahead of time it will help, but it's not required.

2) Systems in scope (confirmed): production API, telemetry/analytics ingestion pipeline, SSO (Okta), and any Redwood-hosted connectors to your data warehouse. Out of scope: ephemeral dev/test environments and local dev machines. I attached a quick "systems in scope" spreadsheet with checkboxes — please update as you confirm.

3) Required artifacts we typically collect during intake (if available):
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest)
- Network diagram showing where Redwood services integrate and what is public vs private
- High-level data flow diagram (which data fields are sent to Redwood, retention, and export policies)
- List of third-party processors and any regional restrictions
- Point of contact for procurement and contract redlines

4) Timeline: Per your Q3 goal, we'll aim to complete the evidence review within 2 weeks of receiving the questionnaire + artifacts. If SOC 2 or additional audits are requested, that may extend the timeline — we'll flag those early.

Invite: I've sent a calendar invite for Tue 9/1 14:00-15:00 PDT. Link to the intake doc and checklist: https://drive.google.com/medora-security-questionnaire (view/comment).

Attachments: updated Medora_Systems_In_Scope.xlsx (marked with confirmed scope)

See you on Tuesday, and thanks again for the quick coordination.

—
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

I'll update the intake doc with tracking columns for 'requested', 'received', and 'owner' so procurement can see progress. If you want, I can draft the standard redline talking points for procurement so we can reduce back-and-forth.

Thanks, Neha
